clue.text: They go from do to do

definitions.text: They go from do to do

parts.words: They go from do to do
parts.note: in sol-fa singing practice, a run of notes climbs from the low doh up to the doh an octave above

explanation.surface: Something that goes from one party to another, a social butterfly perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do' looks like a party, but here it is the sol-fa note doh.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical exercise of eight notes runs from one tonic doh to the next, octave to octave.

clue.text: County agents entertaining doctor in old city

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to have them within, so the agents hold the rest

parts.note: CIA is the American intelligence agency, full of agents

indicators.note: the doctor sits inside the old city

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: Spies in some county host a medic in an ancient town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'County' first suggests a county abbreviation; the definition is the whole of the county itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Cumbria is a county in north-west England, home of the Lake District.

clue.text: Philosopher offers something hairy: introduction to epistemology

parts.note: a lock is a tress of hair

indicators.note: the introduction of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A thinker tackles a hairy problem as a way into the theory of knowledge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'something hairy' suggests a difficulty, but it is a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: John Locke was the seventeenth-century English empiricist thinker.

clue.text: Holy son wants holy form of worship

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
pi is informal British slang for pious or sanctimonious
a ritual is a set ceremonial form of religious observance

explanation.surface: A pious boy wants a sacred rite.
explanation.definitionFit: Spiritual means relating to religion or the soul, a near synonym of sacred.

clue.text: Modifies colourful boats

parts.note: red is a colour, so colourful here stands for red
rafts are simple flat boats

explanation.surface: Someone alters a description of brightly painted vessels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Modifies' reads as a verb acting on the boats, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To redraft a text is to rewrite and so revise or alter it.

clue.text: Acts of defiance from engineers attending electrical units

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
volts are units of electric potential

explanation.surface: Engineers protest while working on electrical equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Revolts are uprisings or rebellions against authority.

clue.text: Daughter is going round the Spanish shops

indicators.note: the daughter and is surround the Spanish article

parts.note: D is the genealogical abbreviation for daughter
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A daughter makes a tour of the Spanish shops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going round' has the daughter and 'is' wrap the article, split on either side of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Delis, short for delicatessens, are shops selling cooked meats and fine foods.

clue.text: Right troublesome goddess seen in commercial is divorced

indicators.note: the right and goddess are seen inside the advert

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid
Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin

explanation.surface: An advertisement featuring an awkward deity is a separation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right' here is a legal claim rather than a direction or correctness.
explanation.definitionFit: Alienated means estranged or cut off, as a couple separated from each other.

clue.text: Number celebrate, becoming screwed up

parts.note: ten is a number
to sing is to celebrate, as in singing someone's praises

explanation.surface: A group celebrates while growing nervous.
explanation.definitionFit: Tensing describes muscles tightening, being wound or screwed up taut.

clue.text: Scotsman? A villain, he, terribly devious politically?

parts.note: Mac is a familiar term for a Scotsman

indicators.note: terribly suggests the letters are put together badly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Scot is a terrible rogue, cunning in politics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terribly' rearranges A VILLAIN HE into HIAVELLIAN, after MAC.
explanation.definitionFit: After Niccolo Machiavelli, the adjective describes cunning, unscrupulous statecraft.

clue.text: Legal document not charged for offers autonomy

parts.note: something not charged for is free
a will is a legal document disposing of an estate

explanation.surface: A legal document given gratis offers independence.
explanation.definitionFit: Free will is the power to act of one's own accord, self-determination.

clue.text: Coin of little value, money submitted

parts.note: a sen is a small Japanese and South-East Asian coin
tin is old British slang for money

explanation.surface: A low-value coin is handed in as cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To have sent something in is to have submitted it, as an entry or application.

clue.text: Light gold carriage

parts.note: to light, as a bird lights on a branch, is to land
Au is the chemical symbol for gold

explanation.surface: A pale golden coach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light' looks like an adjective for gold, but it is the verb to alight.
explanation.definitionFit: A landau is a four-wheeled horse-drawn coach with a folding top.

clue.text: Hopeless situation in country south of barrier

indicators.note: in a down entry the country sits below, so south of, the barrier

parts.note: a dam is a barrier holding back water
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A desperate state of affairs in a land below a dam.
explanation.definitionFit: Damnation is eternal punishment, the ultimate state beyond hope.

clue.text: Place of battle has a king in holy army with long garment on

indicators.note: the a and king go inside the holy army

parts.note: SA is the Salvation Army, a Christian army
R is short for rex, Latin for king
a toga is the long robe of ancient Rome

explanation.surface: A battlefield where a monarch joins a religious army wearing robes.
explanation.definitionFit: Saratoga, New York, saw the 1777 American victory turning the Revolutionary War.

clue.text: Back in a match after earlier loss?

definitions.text: Back in a match after earlier loss?

parts.words: Back in a match after earlier loss?
parts.note: a match is also a marriage; to be back in one after losing a spouse is to wed again

explanation.surface: A sportsman returns to play after a defeat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'match' and 'loss' suggest a game; the match is a marriage and the loss a spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A person wed again after divorce or bereavement has entered a second union.

clue.text: Good-for-nothing finally seen through complained

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the hyphenated word

parts.note: rumbled is British slang for found out or seen through

explanation.surface: A layabout was finally exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: Grumbled means muttered discontentedly, a mild synonym of protested.

clue.text: Always getting upset, imbibing drinks — unfortunate medical state

indicators.note: imbibing means taking in, so the drinks go inside
upset in a down entry means turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, always
laps means drinks, as a cat laps milk

explanation.surface: Someone forever getting distressed while drinking has a sorry condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting upset' turns EER into REE; 'imbibing' puts LAPS inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A relapse is a return of illness after apparent recovery, a medical setback.

clue.text: Ordained member of cathedral staff half ignored set of beliefs

indicators.note: half the word is ignored, leaving just its front half

parts.note: a dean heads a cathedral chapter
a creed is a statement of beliefs

explanation.surface: A church official, half disregarded, set out the doctrine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ordained' looks like it describes the cleric, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordained in the sense of decreed means ordered or laid down by authority.

clue.text: Two ways to be self-effacing

parts.note: a mode is a way and ST, street, is a way; together these two ways spell a word for humble

explanation.surface: A puzzle about two methods of being humble.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter splits the word into two synonyms for way: a manner of doing and a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Modest people play down their own merits, being unassuming.

clue.text: Bone in back? Er… !

parts.note: the stern is the back of a ship
um, like er, is a hesitation noise

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates over where a bone is in their back.
explanation.definitionFit: The breastbone in the chest is this flat bone joined to the ribs.

clue.text: Stick around, then go

parts.note: c, circa, means around, as with dates
to leave is to go

explanation.surface: Hang about for a while, then depart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stick around' looks like one phrase, but 'Stick' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To cleave to something is to adhere or cling to it.

clue.text: Vessels in channel beginning to sink to the bottom

indicators.text: beginning to sink to the bottom
indicators.note: the opening letter is sent down to the foot of this down entry

parts.note: a sewer is a channel for waste water

explanation.surface: Ships in a canal start to go down.
explanation.walkthrough: The S that begins SEWER sinks to the bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: Ewers are large jugs, vessels for holding water.

clue.text: Worried about female ending being fondled

indicators.note: about means around, so the worried word goes around the ending

parts.note: cared can mean worried, as in cared about something
-ess is the suffix forming female nouns, as in lioness

explanation.surface: Anxious about a woman whose ending was being cuddled.
explanation.definitionFit: Caressed means stroked or touched lovingly, past participle as in being fondled.

clue.text: Hope to avoid a feature of high church?

indicators.note: to avoid the letter is to leave it out

parts.note: to aspire is to hope

explanation.surface: A wish to steer clear of elaborate Anglo-Catholic ritual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high church' suggests ritual worship, but it means a tall church building.
explanation.definitionFit: A steeple's tapering top rises high on a church building.

clue.text: Mini-map erred, I fancy, showing line through London

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A small map has gone wrong, showing a line through London.
explanation.definitionFit: The zero-longitude reference line passes through Greenwich in London.

clue.text: Like member of pre-Christmas team newly endorsed

indicators.note: newly signals the letters made anew in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A reindeer from Santa's team is freshly backed.
explanation.walkthrough: The team is Santa's reindeer, which pull the sleigh on Christmas Eve.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudolph, the shiny-nosed reindeer, belongs to Santa's sleigh team.

clue.text: Romantic doctor meets Eastern girl

parts.note: Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A doctor meets an oriental woman, romantically.
explanation.definitionFit: Dreamy means idealistic and sentimental, given to fanciful thoughts.
